atDirectives.name: @layer exsa.tokens
atDirectives.description: EXSA Layer 1 — Design tokens (:root custom properties)

atDirectives.name: @layer exsa.reset
atDirectives.description: EXSA Layer 2 — Box model, focus, scrollbar, RTL, body defaults

atDirectives.name: @layer exsa.layout
atDirectives.description: EXSA Layer 3 — Flex, grid, containers, breakpoints

atDirectives.name: @layer exsa.elements
atDirectives.description: EXSA Layer 4 — Classless element styles for nav, table, form, button, blockquote, dialog, and more (opt-in via .exsa)

atDirectives.name: @layer exsa.components
atDirectives.description: EXSA Layer 5 — 53 plug-and-play BEM components. Each is one CSS file.

properties.name: --color-bg-secondary
properties.description: Secondary background (cards, inputs, hover states). Default: #e9e9e9

properties.name: --color-text-secondary
properties.description: Secondary/muted text (captions, helpers, disabled). Default: #757575 — WCAG AA on white

properties.name: --color-link
properties.description: Link color and primary accent. Default: #118bee

properties.name: --color-accent
properties.description: Subtle blue background tint (code, even rows). Default: #118bee15

properties.name: --color-scrollbar
properties.description: Scrollbar thumb color. Default: auto-derived from --color-text

properties.name: --color-success
properties.description: Success state color (green). Used by buttons, badge, alert, toast, form-validation. Default: #16a34a

properties.name: --color-danger
properties.description: Danger/error state color (red). Used by buttons, badge, alert, toast, form-validation. Default: #dc2626

properties.name: --color-warning
properties.description: Warning state color (amber). Used by buttons, badge, alert. Default: #d97706

properties.name: --color-button-text
properties.description: Button text color (defined by themes). Fallback: #fff

properties.name: --color-button-text-inverse
properties.description: Button text on dark backgrounds. Default: #000 (light) / #eee (dark)

properties.name: --font-family-mono
properties.description: Monospace font stack for code. Default: SF Mono, Cascadia Code, Fira Code, Consolas

properties.name: --font-family-heading
properties.description: Heading font family (falls back to --font-family). Premium fonts target this token.

properties.name: --border-radius
properties.description: Border radius for cards, buttons, inputs. Default: 5px

properties.name: --blockquote-border
properties.description: Blockquote left border pipe. Default: none (opt-in). Set to e.g. '4px solid var(--color-link)'

properties.name: --scroll-margin-top
properties.description: Anchor scroll offset for fixed topbars. Default: 80px

properties.name: --bp-sm
properties.description: Small breakpoint (max-width). Default: 575px. Reference values — cannot be used in @media queries yet.

properties.name: --card-padding
properties.description: Card inner padding (full-bleed sync). Default: var(--gap-lg). Scoped to section aside.

properties.name: --space-factor
properties.description: Spacing multiplier for density profiles. Default: 1. Compact=0.8, Spacious=1.3

properties.name: --radius-factor
properties.description: Radius multiplier for density profiles. Default: 1. Compact=0.85, Spacious=1.2

properties.name: --font-factor
properties.description: Font size multiplier for density profiles. Default: 1. Compact=0.95, Spacious=1.1

properties.name: --motion-factor
properties.description: Animation intensity multiplier. Default: 1. Compact=0.6, Spacious=1.4. prefers-reduced-motion sets to 0.

properties.name: --justify-heading
properties.description: Text alignment for headings and centered content. Default: center

properties.name: --justify-body
properties.description: Text alignment for body, forms, and tables. Default: start (auto-flips in RTL)

properties.name: --justify-nav
properties.description: Nav alignment. Default: space-between. Override via var() fallback.

properties.name: --z-dropdown
properties.description: Dropdowns, tooltips, date/color picker popups. Default: 100

properties.name: --z-modal
properties.description: Modal dialogs + video modals (above topbar). Default: 1050

properties.name: --z-layout-aside
properties.description: Fixed sidebars in layout shells. Default: 90
